decisions.reason: The air quality sensor got its own product page and fits the firm's announced expansion of its sensor module platform, and demand for indoor air monitoring rose after 2020, so the invested firmware, API bindings and visible commitment favour keeping it.
A voltage measurement module is a core building block of the modular measurement platform and costs little to keep once its firmware and bindings exist, so management keeps it.

The CAN bus interface extends the platform's connectivity options for automation customers, matching the stated strategy, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary causes such as chip shortages, so it stays.
The CO2 sensor module was showcased on its own page and gained relevance with ventilation monitoring during the pandemic, so the firm's investment and public commitment support keeping it.
